Q97: reversed the Q71 pending-review decline on new evidence. Old note: "rule-based: position-rule marker in the radius-ulna frame, boundary by the marker watershed on her fascial septa; 23.9 cm3. NOT yet confirmed against a textbook volume range -- review before setting atlas_id." Re-checked with this session's mesh-topology tools (which post-date Q71): isolated test conversion gives 22.6 cm3 mesh volume, 4 components, largest 98.8% (face-adjacency connected components), watertight, a plausible elongated dorsal-forearm-extensor extent (not a blob), and 0.0% of vertices outside her raw skin surface (nearest-vertex normal test, matching the bar used for a subcutaneous/deep muscle). Her own right-side twin, extensor_digitorum_r shipped 19.7 cm3 (ct_vhf_forearm mapping, same subject, same rule-based pipeline) -- a close bilateral match. Render QA (isolated and in skin context) shows the deep-extensor-compartment 'outcropping' group (APL/EPB/EPL) converging toward the wrist alongside extensor_digitorum/extensor_digiti_minimi, exactly the expected anatomical layout. Shipped from her own left-forearm cryosection segmentation (Q71).
